2607.05238.title: MoP-JEPA: Hard-Assigned Predictor Mixtures for Stochastic JEPA World Models
2607.05238.paper_summary: JEPA world models predict the next latent state with a single deterministic predictor trained by latent regression. We show that this fails structurally when the environment is stochastic: at a branching transition, the regression-optimal predictor outputs the conditional mean of the successor embeddings, a point between the true next states that corresponds to no state at all. We prove this collapse for deterministic and gated mixture-of-experts predictors, and prove that MoP-JEPA's hard-assigned predictors converge instead to a quantizer of the transition distribution: one head per successor mode, enumerable in a single forward pass, which is the interface a planner consumes. On official OGBench offline data with leak-free evaluation, planning over single-predictor rollouts performs poorly ($0.02$--$0.09$ success) while planning over our predicted modes reaches up to $0.85$, ahead of deterministic, gated-MoE, and variational predictors on every task. Because multi-prediction evaluation invites coverage freeloading, a verification protocol is part of the method: an input-agnostic codebook control, a shuffled-context test, router-gated readouts, transition-precision guards, and a verified-route criterion in which the model proposes its transition graph blind and ground truth is used only to check the result. Under this criterion our method outperforms the strongest soft alternative on all three mazes ($2$--$5\times$), and the protocol identifies the remaining gap in that baseline's raw scores as routes through predicted transitions that do not exist. The same model executes in the real environment, placing second of seven against the published OGBench baselines on the hardest maze. Multimodal dynamics decide whether a JEPA world model can plan at all; a mixture of predictors with hard assignment is a minimal and verifiable fix.
2607.05238.paper_summary_zh: JEPA 世界模型使用單一的確定性預測器，透過潛在回歸來預測下一個潛在狀態。<lb/>我們顯示當環境是隨機時，這在結構上會失敗：在分支轉換時，回歸最佳預測器輸出後繼嵌入的條件均值，這是一個介於真實下一狀態之間的點，對應於根本不存在的狀態。<lb/>我們證明了這一崩潰對於確定性和門控的專家混合預測器都是成立的，並證明 MoP-JEPA 的硬分配預測器則收斂到轉換分佈的量化器：每個後繼模式一個頭，在單次前向傳遞中可枚舉，這是規劃者所消耗的介面。<lb/>在官方 OGBench 離線數據上，進行無洩漏評估的單一預測器展開規劃表現不佳（$0.02$--$0.09$ 的成功率），而基於我們預測的模式的規劃則可達到高達 $0.85$，在每個任務上均超越確定性、門控-MoE 和變分預測器。<lb/>因為多重預測評估會引發覆蓋搭便車，驗證協議是該方法的一部分：一個與輸入無關的碼本控制、一個隨機上下文測試、路由門控讀出、轉換精度保護，以及一個驗證路徑標準，其中模型盲目提出其轉換圖，並僅使用真實數據來檢查結果。<lb/>在這一標準下，我們的方法在所有三個迷宮中超越了最強的軟替代方案（$2$--$5\times$），而該協議確定了該基線原始分數中剩餘的差距是通過不存在的預測轉換的路徑。<lb/>同樣的模型在真實環境中執行，並在最困難的迷宮中對七個參賽者中名列第二，超越了已發表的 OGBench 基線。<lb/>多模態動力學決定了 JEPA 世界模型是否能夠進行規劃；硬分配的預測器混合是一個最小且可驗證的修正。
